title: Long Mate Pair Library Construction Protocol
author: Graham J Etherington
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd3ui8nw
materials: During exonuclease treatment 240 µL of M280 Dynabeads (Thermo Fisher) were prepared by washing twice with 600 µL Bead Bind Buffer (Illumina) before resuspending in 1560 µL Bead Bind Buffer.

A master mix containing 1105 µL nuclease free water, 130 µL 10x End Repair Reaction Buffer (NEB, Hitchin, UK) and 65 µL end repair enzyme mix (NEB) was prepared and 100 µL added to each tube, mixed with the beads and incubated at Room temperature for 00:30:00 .

A master mix containing 325 µL nuclease free water, 39 µL A Tailing 10x Reaction Buffer (NEB) and 26 µL A tailing enzyme mix (NEB) was prepared and 30 µL added to each tube, mixed with the beads and incubated at 37 °C for 00:30:00 .

To the A tailed library molecules 1 µL of the appropriate Illumina Index adapter (Illumina) was added and mixed then 31 µL of Blunt/ TA ligase (NEB) added and incubated at Room temperature for 00:10:00 .

Each sample was then subjected to amplification on a Veriti Thermal Cycler (Thermo Fisher) with the following conditions: 98 °C for 00:03:00 , 8, 10 or 12 cycles of PCR depending upon copy number entering circularisation of 98 °C for 00:00:10 , 60 °C for 00:00:30 , 72 °C for 00:00:30 followed by 72 °C for 00:05:00 and Hold at 4 °C .

steps.title: Tagmentation Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare two tagmentation reactions using 3 µg of Genomic DNA each.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 3 µg of Genomic DNA in 308 µL.
Add 80 µL 5x Tagment Buffer Mate Pair (Illumina) and 12 µL Mate Pair Tagmentation Enzyme (Illumina).
Gently vortex to mix.
Incubate for 00:30:00 at 55 °C.
Add 100 µL of Neutralize Tagment Buffer (Illumina) and incubate at Room temperature for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Tagmentation Clean-up and QC
steps.instruction: Perform bead clean-up and quantify the tagmented DNA.

substeps.instruction: Perform a 1x volume bead clean-up using CleanPCR beads.
Elute DNA in 165 µL of Nuclease free Water.
Run a 1 µL aliquot on a BioAnalyser 1200 chip and determine DNA concentration using a Qubit HS Assay.

steps.title: Strand Displacement
steps.instruction: Perform strand displacement on the tagmented DNA.

substeps.instruction: Combine 162 µL of tagmented DNA, 20 µL 10x Strand Displacement Buffer (Illumina), 8 µL dNTPs (Illumina), and 10 µL Strand Displacement Polymerase (Illumina).
Incubate at Room temperature for 00:30:00.

steps.title: Strand Displacement Clean-up and Pooling
steps.instruction: Clean up the strand displaced DNA and pool the reactions.

substeps.instruction: Perform a 0.75x volume bead clean-up with CleanPCR beads.
Elute DNA in 16 µL of Nuclease free Water.
Pool the eluted DNA from the two 3 µg reactions.
Dilute a 1 µL aliquot 1:6 and run on a BioAnalyser 1200 chip and determine DNA concentration using a Qubit HS Assay.

steps.title: Size Selection
steps.instruction: Perform size selection using a Sage Science ELF system.

substeps.instruction: Replace 30 µL in each collection well with fresh buffer and check collection and elution current.
Add 10 µL of loading solution to 30 µL of the pooled Strand Displaced reaction.
Load onto a 0.75% Cassette; configure to separate the sample for 03:30:00 and elute each fraction for 00:35:00.
Recover 30 µL from each of the 12 collection wells and determine DNA concentration using a Qubit HS Assay.

steps.title: Circularisation and Linear DNA Digestion
steps.instruction: Circularise the size-fractionated DNA and digest remaining linear DNA.

substeps.instruction: Combine 30 µL of size fractionated DNA, 12.5 µL of 10x circularisation buffer (Illumina), 3 µL Circularisation Enzyme (Illumina), and 85 µL nuclease free water.
Incubate at 30 °C overnight.
Digest linear DNA by adding 3.75 µL Exonuclease (Illumina).
Incubate at 37 °C for 00:30:00, then at 70 °C for 00:30:00 to denature the enzyme.
Add 5 µL of stop ligation (Illumina).

steps.title: DNA Shearing
steps.instruction: Shear the circularised DNA using a Covaris S2.

substeps.instruction: Shear DNA in a 130 µL volume for 2 cycles of 00:00:37 with a duty cycle of 10%, cycles per burst of 200, and intensity of 4.

steps.title: Bead Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind fragmented DNA to M280 beads and perform sequential washes.

substeps.instruction: Add 130 µL of washed M280 beads to 130 µL of fragmented DNA, mix, and place on a lab rotator at Room temperature for 00:20:00.
Wash library molecules bound to M280 beads four times with 200 µL Bead Washer Buffer (Illumina) and twice with 200 µL Resuspension Buffer (Illumina).
Wash end repaired library molecules bound to M280 beads four times with 200 µL Bead Washer Buffer and twice using 200 µL Resuspension Buffer.
Add 5 µL of stop ligation post-incubation.
Wash adapter ligated library molecules bound to M280 beads four times with 200 µL Bead Washer Buffer and twice with 200 µL Resuspension Buffer.

steps.title: Library Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the library using a PCR master mix.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a master mix containing 240 µL nuclease free water, 300 µL 2x Kappa HiFi (Kappa Biosystems), and 60 µL Illumina Primer Cocktail (Illumina).
Add 50 µL of master mix to each tube, mix with the beads, and transfer contents (including beads) to a 200 µL PCR tube.

steps.title: Final Library Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover and purify the final library from the PCR reaction.

substeps.instruction: Place PCR tubes on a magnetic plate to pellet beads and transfer 45 µL of the PCR to a 2 mL Lobind Eppendorf Tube.
Add 31.5 µL of CleanPCR beads to precipitate the DNA.
Wash beads twice with 70% ethanol.
Elute the final library in 20 µL resuspension buffer.

steps.title: Library QC and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Perform final quality control and sequence the libraries.

substeps.instruction: Run a 1 µL aliquot on a High Sensitivity BioAnalyser chip and measure DNA concentration using the High Sensitivity Qubit.
Pool libraries based on DNA concentration.
Quantify the pool using the Kappa qPCR Illumina quantification kit.
Run the pool at 10pM on a HiSeq with a 2x250bp reads read metric.
